description: Planning sensitivity model of the original campaigns (gains calibrated on SPACEMOBILE-008 with the nearest-bin energy, beacon power 120 W). It defines sigma_min for the Phase 2 selection (phase2_plan.py), for the binned detection probabilities of the blind searches (blind_analyze.py, phase2_compare.py, eclipse.py) and for Fig. 9a. It reproduces the archived selection (results/phase2_byfile.json) exactly. The recalibrated model of Section 9 is results/detect_theory.json.
